implementation.name: MCL86
implementation.notes: License: MIT, from the per-file header of https://github.com/MicroCoreLabs/Projects/blob/master/MCL86/Core/biu_max.v ("Copyright (c) 2020 Ted Fried" + verbatim MIT text); the monorepo has no root LICENSE file. No is_top path: the core ships as a bus interface unit (biu_max.v for maximum mode, biu_min.v for minimum mode) plus an execution unit (eu.v) with no single checked-in top-level wrapper. The repo README describes MCL86 as an "Intel 8086/8088" microsequencer core, hence both parts are linked; biu_max.v and biu_min.v correspond to the 8086/8088 MX pin modes. accuracy_id omitted: no fidelity claim in the repository.
